newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie 4-week December sales up.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie 4-week December sales up.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended December 28 rose 7.6 percent.
Total sales for that period rose 12.8 percent to $194.1 million compared to the year-ago period ended December 30, 1995.

"The sales results during the 1996 holiday season were in line with my expectations," Stanton Bluestone, chairman, said in a statement. "We experienced strong selling in men's and women's apparel, fragrances, and the tabletop area. Our four new store locations also continued to perform very well."
Carson said these four-week sales are not indicative of results that will be reported for the five-week period ending January 4, 1997.
The company said it currently anticipates that its same store sales for the five-week fiscal December period will be slightly below the year-end five-week period ended December 30, 1995.
The five-week results are expected to be reported on January 9.
The company said it chose to report four-week sales results because many other major retailers opted to do so.
Carson Pirie operates 53 department stores and four furniture stores.
